name: UI Review
author: Brett
description: Every UI a build makes comes here for Brett's approval, one section per kind (open registry: Design packs, Whole apps / programs, Screens & pages, Settings interfaces, Dialogs & popups, Menus & toolbars, Banners & cards, Other). Each item carries its app, build, branch and PR, desktop + phone screenshots, notes, a status (waiting, approved, changes asked, rejected), his comment and its history. Views: tree, collapsible grid, grid with sub-grids, gallery and side-by-side compare, all with multi-select and bulk Approve / Ask changes / Reject. Builds submit through review.mjs, POST /api/plugins/ui-review/submit or rebuild-shots --submit; other plugins read the per-branch / per-PR state through the ui-review@1 capability. Design packs (formerly their own plugin) are one section: pick up to 3. Screenshots tab (ui-screenshot@1): ad-hoc pictures (check sessions, live captures, PR before/after, uploads) that never enter the approve / reject queue, saved with axf shot / POST shots / Upload; grid grouped by app, screen, source or day, thumbnails, full-screen viewer with before/after slider, copy link, delete, Send to review. Predicted looks (ui-prediction@1): when a build that changes UI is launched, framework/cli/ui-predict.mjs makes a mockup of each screen it will touch (framework controls, current theme, demo data) and files it here as 'Predicted - approve the look' next to the screen as it is now; Approve look / Ask changes (the comment goes to the build) / Reject (the build is held). Setting: wait for the look approval before UI builds start. The predicted pictures refresh while the build runs and the real after-shots replace them at the end (badge Real, predicted vs real compare).

items.title: List predicted looks
items.description: Every predicted look (ui-prediction@1) in UI Review, or one build's, with its look gate verdict (go / wait / held) and the 'wait for my look approval' setting.
items.output: { settings, items: ui-review-item@1[] with verdict, verdict? }

items.title: Predict a build's look
items.description: Make (or refresh) a build's predicted item: the mockup pictures (predicted-*.png) and the screen as it is now (before-*.png). framework/cli/ui-predict.mjs predict <build> makes the pictures and calls this.

items.title: Real shots replace the predicted look
items.description: The build finished: its real after-shots replace the mockup (badge Real); the item waits for the real approval, the look decision and the predicted pictures stay for the compare.

items.title: Decide a predicted look
items.description: Brett's decision on a build's predicted look: approve, changes (the comment goes to the build as an addendum) or reject (the build is held).

items.title: Look approval setting
items.description: 'Wait for my look approval before UI builds start' (waitForLook, default off).

items.title: Set the look approval setting
items.description: Turn 'Wait for my look approval before UI builds start' on or off.
